Class SimulationState

java.lang.Object
moldsim.model.SimulationState
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class SimulationState extends Object implements Serializable
Complete serialized state of the simulation used for save and load operations.

This object contains all wall contexts, environment values, simulation step, and historical snapshots required to fully restore a simulation session.
